agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 College and Overall government pages both explicitly list BSSS College in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
The official website and campus address identify the same BSSS institution in Bhopal.
Normal TLS verification hit the managed-network proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; after confirming the expected official hosts, public GET requests used curl --insecure as permitted.

The official site has a current 2026-27 admissions catalogue, but it also retains separate programme pages for BA Management and international/ACCA/CMA offerings outside that catalogue. Its College Profile states 46 certificate courses, 6 diploma courses and 2 additional courses, which does not reconcile with the enumerated 2026-27 certificate page. The site also provides no unified doctoral-programme inventory. Catalogue completeness therefore requires manual review.
Career-tree mappings were read from assets/data/career_path.db using read-only SQLite queries; the database was not edited.
